description: This file contains CUDA-specific implementations of grid sampling functions (2D and 3D) for the ATen tensor library, including forward and backward operations used in differentiable image transformations.

methods.name: Tensor grid_sampler_2d_cuda(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & grid,int64_t interpolation_mode,int64_t padding_mode,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Performs 2D grid sampling on CUDA tensor inputs, generating an output tensor based on input and grid tensors with specified interpolation and padding modes.

methods.name: Tensor grid_sampler_3d_cuda(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & grid,int64_t interpolation_mode,int64_t padding_mode,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Performs 3D grid sampling on CUDA tensor inputs, generating an output tensor based on input and grid tensors with specified interpolation and padding modes.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor> grid_sampler_2d_backward_cuda(const Tensor & grad_output,const Tensor & input,const Tensor & grid,int64_t interpolation_mode,int64_t padding_mode,bool align_corners,std::array<bool,2> output_mask)
methods.description: Computes backward pass for 2D grid sampling, returning gradients with respect to input and grid.
